simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מִסְפָּחָה (H4555) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מִסְפָּחָה (miçpâchâh) means a veil (as spread out) First listed occurrence: Ezek 13 18.

definitions.full: H4555. mispachah [ מִסְמָּחָה ] noun feminine long veil (properly sheathing?) covering whole person; plural absolute עַלרֿאֹשׁ הַמִּסְמָּחוֺת וְעשֹׁוֺת Ezek 13:18 ; suffix מִסְמְּחֹתֵיכֶם 13:21 . סִמַּי see ספף .
